category_title: EFL children with learning difficulties exhibiting behavioral disengagement and low motivation
scenario_title: VoiceThread recording and sentence review practice
minimal_context: The student is using the VoiceThread online system to review summary sentences and record their own reading.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to review the summary sentences on the VoiceThread page and record your own reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do it. I am afraid of my regular English class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just look at the sentences on the screen together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away from the screen) I have no interest in this storytelling.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please click the button so we can start the recording practice.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! I will not come if I have to do recording.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to review the summary sentences on the VoiceThread page and record your own reading.

STUDENT: I don't want to do it. I am afraid of my regular English class.

TUTOR: Let's just look at the sentences on the screen together.

STUDENT: (Looks away from the screen) I have no interest in this storytelling.

TUTOR: Please click the button so we can start the recording practice.

STUDENT: No! I will not come if I have to do recording.

task.content: Reviewing the sentences and recording his own reading
task.learning_goal: Reading the summary sentences out loud

context.materials: VoiceThread online recording system, storylines, pictures, color marker doodling function

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When informed they had to participate in recording practices
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Some pupils said they would not come if they had to do recording.

behavior_patterns.condition: When initially faced with English tasks
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Afraid of their regular English class
